function teardownBurn(s): void

Defined in: website/components/home/mosaic/burn/loop.ts:24

Final session teardown — restores the DOM title's ink, drops the burn canvas + rewrite slot, and detaches the session from its card. Runs when a reversed (rebuild) pass reaches progress 0; the pristine raster painted that frame is pixel-identical to the restored DOM text, so the handoff is seamless.

Parameters

s

BurnSession

The finished session — torn down in place.

Returns

void
